title: Bicycle Chain
statementMd:
Vasya's bicycle chain drive consists of two parts: $*n*$ stars are attached to the pedal axle, $*m*$ stars are attached to the rear wheel axle. The chain helps to rotate the rear wheel by transmitting the pedal rotation.

We know that the $*i*$-th star on the pedal axle has $*a*_{*i*}$ $(0 < *a*_{1} < *a*_{2} < ... < *a*_{*n*})$ teeth, and the $*j*$-th star on the rear wheel axle has $*b*_{*j*}$ $(0 < *b*_{1} < *b*_{2} < ... < *b*_{*m*})$ teeth. Any pair $(*i*, *j*)$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$; $1 ≤ *j* ≤ *m*)$ is called a *gear* and sets the indexes of stars to which the chain is currently attached. Gear $(*i*, *j*)$ has a gear ratio, equal to the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9cf05374cbe76cb1f58008e81ec7e7e5babeaf22.png).

Since Vasya likes integers, he wants to find such gears $(*i*, *j*)$, that their ratios are integers. On the other hand, Vasya likes fast driving, so among all "integer" gears $(*i*, *j*)$ he wants to choose a gear with the maximum ratio. Help him to find the number of such gears.

In the problem, fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9cf05374cbe76cb1f58008e81ec7e7e5babeaf22.png) denotes division in real numbers, that is, no rounding is performed.

## Input

The first input line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50)$ — the number of stars on the bicycle's pedal axle. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4})$ in the order of strict increasing.

The third input line contains integer $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 50)$ — the number of stars on the rear wheel axle. The fourth line contains $*m*$ integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4})$ in the order of strict increasing.

It is guaranteed that there exists at least one gear ($*i*, *j*$), that its gear ratio is an integer. The numbers on the lines are separated by spaces.

## Output

Print the number of "integer" gears with the maximum ratio among all "integer" gears.

## Note

In the first sample the maximum "integer" gear ratio equals 3. There are two gears that have such gear ratio. For one of them $*a*_{1} = 4, *b*_{1} = 12$, and for the other $*a*_{2} = 5, *b*_{3} = 15$.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 的自行车链条传动系统由两部分组成：脚踏轴上安装了 $*n*$ 个链轮，后轮轴上安装了 $*m*$ 个链轮。链条通过传递脚踏的转动来带动后轮旋转。

我们知道，脚踏轴上的第 $*i*$ 个链轮有 $*a*_{*i}$ $(0 < *a*_{1} < *a*_{2} < ... < *a*_{*n*})$ 个齿，后轮轴上的第 $*j*$ 个链轮有 $*b*_{*j}$ $(0 < *b*_{1} < *b*_{2} < ... < *b*_{*m*})$ 个齿。任意一对 $(*i*, *j*)$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$; $1 ≤ *j* ≤ *m*)$ 都称为一种*齿轮组合*，表示链条当前连接的两个链轮的编号。齿轮组合 $(*i*, *j*)$ 的传动比等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9cf05374cbe76cb1f58008e81ec7e7e5babeaf22.png)。

由于 Vasya 喜欢整数，他希望找到传动比为整数的齿轮组合 $(*i*, *j*)$。另一方面，Vasya 喜欢快速骑行，因此在所有“整数”齿轮组合 $(*i*, *j*)$ 中，他希望选择传动比最大的齿轮组合。请帮助他求出具有该最大传动比的齿轮组合数量。

在本题中，分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9cf05374cbe76cb1f58008e81ec7e7e5babeaf22.png) 表示实数除法，即不进行四舍五入。

## 输入格式

第一行输入一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50)$，表示自行车脚踏轴上的链轮数量。第二行输入 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4})$，这些数按严格递增顺序给出。

第三行输入一个整数 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 50)$，表示后轮轴上的链轮数量。第四行输入 $*m*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4})$，这些数按严格递增顺序给出。

保证至少存在一种齿轮组合 $(*i*, *j*)$，其传动比为整数。每行中的数字以空格分隔。

## 输出格式

输出所有“整数”齿轮组合中，具有最大传动比的齿轮组合数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，最大的“整数”传动比为 3。有两种齿轮组合具有该传动比。其中一种满足 $*a*_{1} = 4, *b*_{1} = 12$，另一种满足 $*a*_{2} = 5, *b*_{3} = 15$。
